Freeze cohort selection, scorer/version, aggregation, failed-item handling and invalid/missing result accounting in a machine-readable scoring plan; no such plan is present.
Separate paired, unpaired, synthetic, human and source-reported evidence and validate one invalid and one representative valid bundle through the reported package; no such control bundle is present.
Provide a rights-cleared local subset or explicit approval record before admitting any corpus bytes into evaluation; no approval record is present and local observations are not admitted.
Complete an opt-in adapter/developer-evidence boundary decision with no default, no public processor exposure and no shared build/CI change; no such decision is recorded.
Record explicit default-selection, release/public-benchmark approval and qualification evidence; absent evidence never qualifies and this package remains off by default.
